name: 10950 · Monroe, NY
findings: ZIP 10950 (Monroe) has 315 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (14%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (52% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10950 (Monroe) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10950 (Monroe) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
